node.title: Re: using basename on a list of filesnames
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
One of the many reasons you should always [id://111088]. Look closely at the variables in your loop:

foreach $file (@TIFFfolder_list){ my $file = basename (@TIFFfolder_list, ".psd"); print "$file\n"; }

You've got two $file variables there: the package variable you're using as the loop variable, and the new lexical one you're declaring with my. But you're not passing either of those to the basename function...

BTW, the [doc://File::Basename] doc says that fileparse is a bit safer - and where are you loading that module in the first place?

You're printing the filenames to standard output, but then you're using -body=>"$file", but the variable should be empty at that point. Perhaps you want to set up a new variable into which you concatenate your output via .= instead (or use the [doc://map]/[doc://join] solutions others have alluded to).

Also, note that the [mod://Mail::Sender] docs say the module is deprecated, use [mod://Email::Sender] instead.
